findings.claim: The proposals vote-state tooltips on a German casual install still end in raw English: stateNoteFor appends the hardcoded action suffix " — click to filter this set" / " — click to clear the filter" to the translated count text, and no catalog key or translate call covers it, so the tooltip reads e.g. "1 von 3 angenommen — click to filter this set". spec-4 DR4 lists vote tooltips as residual raw English that must be fully covered by the catalog in non-dev-visible chrome (checklist correctness-32/34).
findings.evidence: Re-read internal/server/proposals.go:581-605 at head: action := "click to filter this set" (585), action = "click to clear the filter" (588), note.Tooltip = tooltip + " — " + action (602); the tooltip argument is translated at 451-454 via translate(language, "%d of %d accepted") etc., but stateNoteFor has no language parameter and the suffix bypasses translate. germanCatalog (internal/server/i18n.go:8-122) has no 'click to' key. proposals.html:62/67/72 render title="{{.Accepted.Tooltip}}" etc. raw (no t). Sequence: profile language: de + audience: casual, a proposals group with >=1 accepted or a non-zero rejected/postponed count -> hovering the + / − / p pill shows the German count followed by English action text. spec-4 DR4 ('Non-dev-visible chrome fully covered by the catalog', naming vote tooltips) — suffix pre-existed at base proposals.go:584/587 but the change set that was required to clean these tooltips left it.
findings.fix: Pass language into stateNoteFor and build the suffix with translate(language, "click to filter this set") / translate(language, "click to clear the filter"), adding both keys to germanCatalog (e.g. "zum Filtern klicken" / "Filter aufheben").
